description: Minimum offline retrieval quality (npm run test:retrieval). Measured with the deterministic eval-lexicon-v1 embedder on eval/datasets/retrieval.jsonl: overall Recall@1/3/5 = 0.68/0.89/0.96, MRR 0.83. The minimums sit below the measured values (and the tolerance below that) so that one flipped question does not fail the check, but a broken FTS query, vector scan, RRF, de-duplication or chunking does: the per-tag entries guard each retrieval path on its own (exact-term needs keyword search, semantic-only needs vector search). Raise them in a PR when quality has genuinely improved.
